title: 고민 상담: 선배, 저 회사 그만둘까요?
objective: Share a worry and comfort someone using -잖아(요).
summary: A junior employee shares her worry about quitting, and her senior advises her.
setting: A quiet café after work. Jisu, a junior employee, looks tired, so her senior Hajun asks what is wrong. Hajun speaks casually and Jisu speaks politely.

task.title: Comfort and remind
task.line: Choose or write the right word or ending so each sentence fits the situation.

words.meaning: "you know" / "after all": reminds the listener of something they already know. Past: -았/었잖아(요).
words.exampleMeaning: You have an exam tomorrow, you know. Go to bed early tonight.

words.meaning: when you actually do it (often different from what you expected)
words.example: 막상 한국에 오니까 말이 잘 안 들렸어요.
words.exampleMeaning: Once I actually came to Korea, I couldn't understand people well.

words.meaning: to decide in a hurry, without enough thought
words.exampleMeaning: Don't rush into signing a lease.

words.meaning: to feel relieved; to feel better inside
words.exampleMeaning: I felt better after talking to my mom on the phone.
If you need help, just tell me anytime.

dialogue.korean: 지수야, 요즘 무슨 고민 있어? 얼굴이 안 좋아 보여.
dialogue.meaning: Jisu, is something bothering you these days? You look down.

dialogue.korean: 사실은 회사를 그만둘까 고민 중이에요. 일이 저하고 안 맞는 것 같아요.
dialogue.meaning: Actually, I'm thinking about quitting. I don't think this job suits me.

dialogue.korean: 그래? 그런데 너 입사할 때 이 일 꼭 하고 싶다고 했잖아.
dialogue.meaning: Really? But when you joined, you said you really wanted to do this job, remember?

dialogue.korean: 그랬죠. 그런데 막상 해 보니까 생각했던 거랑 너무 달라요.
dialogue.meaning: I did. But now that I'm actually doing it, it's very different from what I imagined.

dialogue.korean: 나도 신입 때 그랬어. 처음에는 다 힘들어.
dialogue.meaning: I was the same when I was new. Everything is hard at first.
You too? But you're always so good at your work.

dialogue.korean: 아니야. 나도 실수 많이 했어. 너무 급하게 결정하지 말고 좀 더 생각해 봐.
dialogue.meaning: No way. I made lots of mistakes too. Don't decide in a hurry. Think about it a bit more.

dialogue.korean: 네, 그래야겠어요. 이야기하니까 마음이 좀 편해졌어요.
dialogue.meaning: Okay, I think I should. I feel a bit better after talking.
Call me anytime. We're on the same team, after all.

exercises: Choose the right ending (the listener already knows about the interview): 가: 왜 이렇게 일찍 일어났어? 나: 어제 말했잖아. 오늘 면접 (있잖아 / 있대).
Fill in the blank with -잖아요 (present): 걱정하지 마세요. 수진 씨는 발표를 잘 ____. (하다)
Fill in the blank with -잖아 (past): 가: 왜 이렇게 피곤해? 나: 어제 늦게까지 야근____. (하다)
Choose 막상, 급하게, or 언제든지 for each blank: ① 혼자 사는 게 쉬울 줄 알았는데 ____ 살아 보니까 힘들어요. ② 차를 하루 만에 샀어요? 너무 ____ 산 거 아니에요? ③ 궁금한 게 있으면 ____ 물어보세요.
Fill in the blank with the past form of 편해지다 (해요 style): 실컷 울고 나니까 마음이 ____.
answers: ① 막상 ② 급하게 ③ 언제든지
